name: quotient_equal_different_history_run_b
invariant: See the paired fixture: every raw observable field (option_space, committed, bound, refused_count, history_len) differs from the pair, yet collapse_quotient still places 3 and 4 in the same equivalence class in both runs.
explanation: Here 1 is Refused instead of Popped (so it stays in Omega, and Omega ends at {1,2,3,4} rather than {2,3,4}), and 3/4 are Bound under tag 'kinship' rather than 'adjacent'. Nothing in the raw snapshot matches the paired fixture. But collapse_quotient treats any non-'__meta__'-tagged Bind as a union regardless of tag text, so 3 and 4 still collapse into one equivalence class here exactly as in the pair -- demonstrating that quotient agreement is a strictly coarser, and strictly different, notion than the fixtures/05 pair's terminal-snapshot agreement.
